definitions.short: properly, to wrench , i.e. (figuratively) to subvert
definitions.full: H5557. salaph סָלַף verb twist, pervert, overturn ( סְלַף ᵑ7 twist (rare); Arabic is pass, pass away, come to naught Lane 1407f. ); — Pi`el Imperfect 3masculine singular יְסַלֵּף Job 12:19 2 t., וַיְסַלֵּף Prov 22:12 ; 3 feminine singular תְּסַלֵּף 13:6 ; 19:3 ; Participle מְסַלֵּף 21:12 ; — 1 pervert , Exod 23:8 (E) a bribe perverteth the case (cause, דִּבְרֵי ) of righteous, = Deut 16:19 . 2 subvert, turn upside down, ruin (only Wisdom Literature): with accusative of person Job 12:19 ; Prov 13:6 (opposed to תִּצֹּר ), 21:12 ; דַּרְכּוֺ תּ אָדָם ׳אִוֶּלֶת 19:3 a man's folly subverteth his way ; בֹגֵד דִּבְרֵי וַיְסַלֵּף 22:12 and he ( ׳י ) subverteth the affairs of a treacherous man.

occurrences.englishText: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.
Righteousness guards the way of integrity,
The foolishness of man subverts his way;
The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked,
